featured.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
featured.tldr: DR Pixel does deep research directly on rendered page images instead of OCR text, and a step-weighted fine-tuning method lifts a 27B open model to GPT-5.4-level accuracy.

featured.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
featured.tldr: A stock coding agent drives a simulated two-arm robot through one command line and rewrites small measurement tools after each failure; with no training it reaches 46.9% success on RoboDojo's official evaluation.
